input.rationale: Section 7 contains only a mutual exclusion of consequential/indirect damages (carved out for indemnification and confidentiality breaches); there is no monetary cap on either party's direct liability anywhere in the Agreement (no "aggregate liability" or fee-based limit appears). The playbook requires a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' amounts paid/payable and USD 1,000,000 with uncapped carve-outs. Because the fee model is a revenue share under Section 5 (Kubient pays Customer), a cap keyed only to fees "paid by Customer" would be illusory, so the inserted cap is keyed to amounts paid or payable between the Parties with a USD 1,000,000 floor, and Section 5 payment obligations are excluded from the cap. Carve-outs mirror the existing Section 7(a) exceptions and extend to data protection/security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement.

proposal.summary: Add mutual liability cap (greater of 12 months' amounts or USD 1,000,000) with standard uncapped carve-outs to § 7
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 excludes indirect damages but sets no cap on direct liability, so both parties are exposed without limit. We have added a mutual cap at the greater of amounts paid or payable in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data protection and security breaches, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap; a straight 12-month fee cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct is our fallback.

ops.text: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (i) THE AGGREGATE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BETWEEN THE PARTIES UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (ii) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. AMOUNTS OWED BY A PARTY UNDER SECTION 5 (FEES AND PAYMENT) SHALL NOT BE CONSIDERED DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS SECTION 7(b).
